end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying ways family members care for each other. Trisha shared that they put away their toys and brush their teeth; they also mixed up personal routines with helping jobs, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, ask Trisha to name one small helpful task they can do each morning, such as putting away items or filling a water bottle.
